children: is pushing deeper into travel services through an expanded grocery-delivery partnership with Instacart

, giving guests another reason to remain inside the Airbnb app before and during a trip. The move broadens grocery delivery across the U.S. and signals Airbnb's larger effort to evolve beyond accommodation bookings into a fuller travel platform, potentially creating more engagement and incremental revenue opportunities around each stay.

Guests can now order groceries through Airbnb as much as three weeks before check-in, with $0 delivery fees on qualifying orders of $10 or more. No separate Instacart account is required, and the Airbnb listing address is automatically entered.
The service will also expand to Canada in coming weeks. In Phoenix and Orlando, participating hosts can receive orders and stock refrigerators and pantries before guests arrive.
We wanted groceries to feel like a natural part of a stay, not another errand, Airbnb global head of partnerships and business development Juan David Borrero said.

The nationwide expansion builds on Airbnb's broader 2026 product push. Earlier this year, the company added grocery delivery, car rentals, airport pickups and luggage storage as it worked to capture more of travelers' spending beyond lodging. Grocery delivery had initially been offered in more than 25 U.S. cities through Instacart.

That strategy is beginning to show early traction. Airbnb said in its second-quarter update that bookings for its newer partner services were gaining momentum, while supply for Airbnb Experiences increased nearly 80% year over year.
For Airbnb investors, the key question is whether these services can become meaningful additions to the core lodging business rather than simply convenience features.

Investors should watch booking adoption, how frequently guests attach services such as groceries or airport transportation to stays, and whether those products increase engagement or spending per trip.
The Instacart expansion matters because it takes an offering previously limited to select cities and makes it available across most U.S. stays, while Canada adds another test market.

Airbnb has not yet announced a date for third-quarter earnings, according to its investor-relations calendar. When results arrive, commentary on services growth and monetization will be particularly important in judging whether Airbnb's push beyond homes is developing into a meaningful second growth engine.

title: Airbnb Makes Major Push Beyond Rentals
